title: Image intake in chat: API, Telegram, storage and retention
goal: An image sent in chat is checked, stripped, stored locally and handed to the vision turn
acceptance: Owner decisions 2026-11-26 in chat: fpvbuddy:F-023 "A" (retire the on-device assistant and the vision demo), with "vision capabilities ideally on nerv too"; Italian is required for every model-facing feature (the owner uses all modules in Italian).

POST /api/chat accepts one image (size and type checked by magic bytes, as photos.ts); EXIF/GPS removed before writing; stored under NERV's data directory with its sha256 and a retention sweep that deletes expired chat images

Telegram: a photo with an attach caption (recipe:, crash:, part:, battery:) still attaches as today; any other photo, with or without a caption, goes to the vision turn with the caption as the question
Tests across the join: Telegram update with a photo → stored image → vision turn request; oversize, wrong type and expired images
privacy: Images stay on the owner's machines: no cloud route receives an image; tests use invented images generated in the test (no personal photos, no EXIF from real devices) and no secrets.
validation: npm run check:fast; final applicable CI
escalation: Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26: reuses photos.ts checks; the Telegram routing change and the retention sweep carry most of the work. Not a measurement.
